summary: Implemented patch-level transforms and coordinate output in GridPatchDataset (monai/data/grid_dataset.py). Added `transform` (applied to the tuple of patches per item) and `with_coordinates` (default True, yields (patches, coords) with unpadded start coordinates from the first array). Added tests/test_grid_patch_dataset.py. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Breaking default: with_coordinates=True changes output shape for existing callers; set it to False to keep the old output.
